answer: Proposal: a registrar issues one anonymous credential per verified person — the lotus — uniqueness enforced at issuance. Each epoch the holder's quill is a deterministic nullifier from credential plus epoch tag, ZK-proven against the member tree: the meadow of voters stays unlinkable, yet one credential cannot vote twice without colliding; duplicates are rejected and stake slashed. Extra keys gain nothing; influence needs extra verified people, a linear cost deterring only while it exceeds capped per-identity reward. Issuer capture and credential markets stay open.
